notes.title: Steam trading cards! YouTube fame! And bugfixes, etc.
notes.notes:
Finally! They are here! Steam trading cards are waiting for you to be collected.
When you'll have the whole deck, transform it into a badge, to show the world how good piece of a clock you are. Five levels represents different clocks, ranging from the basic one (sundial) to the most precise one (atomic clock).

So, how good do you clock?

As to fame: Clock Simulator is gaining it on YouTube, where more and more videos are being made about our game. One of polish YouTubers, CyDi, found a bug regarding changing in-game language, which is now fixed. As a token of appreciation, CyDi got a couple of keys to distribute.

To make it easier for YouTubers to record our game, we lowered the volume of some in-game ambient sounds.

Also, the russian in-game language has been made available to you. Friends from Russian Federation, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update! Fixes! Sausages!
notes.notes:
Thanks to user DejaVu, we fixed achievements on mode with 5 chances. Also menu is more responsive to give you a better feeling.

Steam trading cards are on the way, so stay focused and keep clocking!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25717702/ef92434a743048b1c4cc99d5010a135ff68ffda7.png
